course_name_original: Introdução à análise de dados em Python
course_name_en: Introduction to Data Analysis in Python

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire transversal skills in solving management problems and data analysis using the Python language and its libraries, namely using data series available at Pordata and INE.
Use Python and its data analysis support libraries.
Understand the essential concepts of data analysis and management.
Solve problems involving a large volume of data, namely using data series available at Pordata and INE.

syllabus_topics: Use of Python libraries (pandas, numpy, matplotlib, etc).
teaching_methods: Viewing videos and consulting documents on different topics
Accessing bibliographic references and various links
assessment_rules: The assessment methods are based on two components: a distributed component (quizzes in Moodle) and a face-to-face exam. To advance in the different modules of the UC, students must obtain a score above 85% in the 'n -> n+1' transition test. The final grade calculation formula is 100% exam. Eligibility for the final exam requires a rating greater than 85% in the transition test. For special assessment, the distributed component can be replaced by a 'Quiz Global' in Moodle with approval, and only those who pass the distributed component have access to the final exam.
bibliography: Charles R. Severance; Python for everybody
